next.reason: §2023:14.9.37.4 GR9 restates the nonserial search: the initial setting is ignored, varied in an implementor-specified manner, and 'At no time is it set to a value that exceeds the value that corresponds to the last element of the table or is less than the value that corresponds to the first element'; on no match the final setting is undefined and the search unsuccessful, on a match successful. §2023:14.9.37.4 GR1 a) and b) give the same control (imperative-statement-2 or NEXT SENTENCE; AT END or end of SEARCH), and §2023:14.9.37.4 GR8 names the index varied (1985's 'index-name for identifier-1'). The added EC-RANGE-SEARCH-NO-MATCH changes control only when checking is enabled: 'If the AT END phrase is not specified and neither exception condition was raised because the checking for those exception conditions was not enabled, control is transferred to the end of the SEARCH statement' (GR1 b) 3.), which is every 1985 program.
